verdict: approve-with-conditions
Before adding ADRs 0010-0016, resolve the record-placement conflict under R10 with a decision note or ADR and update the affected guidance in the same change. The plan puts tally-specific build, package, parser and counting decisions in docs/adr/, while docs/adr/README.md, “What belongs in this directory”, restricts that directory to constitutive records “generic enough to carry onto any domain”. docs/engineering-discipline.md, “Architecture Decision Records”, also directs architecturally significant structure and interface decisions there. Make the permitted home for these product decisions explicit; do not silently bypass the restriction.
The seven selected options all survive their supplied constraint filters. The cmd/tally layout and unicode.IsSpace selections include reasons for choosing between surviving alternatives; the remaining selections have one survivor each. The choices support REQ-001 through REQ-017 and NFR-018 through NFR-024 without adding product scope or external dependencies.
The four fields and empty tests: list satisfy the architecture plan form. No implementation tests are required in this task. Preserve the existing blank MoSCoW and Phase cells and existing facts records; the plan correctly promises no Go code or new facts record.
At plan scope, the selected technical approach has one reading; the record-placement conflict above is the condition to resolve before execution. This review approves architecture and scope only, not implementation correctness or performance.
